ns2:course.label: Fixed Income Portfolios
ns2:course.description: Conceptual foundations and implementation of strategies for the selection, evaluation, and revision of portfolios of fixed-income financial assets (bonds); examination of related research. Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Finance - UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
